newsitem.title: VIETNAM: American firm in Vietnam golf resort project.
newsitem.headline: American firm in Vietnam golf resort project.

text.p: Government officials said on Tuesday they had awarded a licence to a U.S.-Vietnam joint venture to build a golf course and resort near the northern port city of Haiphong.

An official at the Ministry of Planning and Investment told Reuters the $35.7 million complex would be built by the California Investment Group and a local trading firm, and would include an 18-hole golf course and tourist accommodation.
The U.S. partner would contribute 65 percent of the costs while the remaining contribution from the Vietnamese partner will be in the form of land, he said.

The signing of the licence had originally been expected in May of last year, but the official said changes to the status of the Vietnamese partner and alterations to the project plans had caused delays.

An existing golf course in northern Vietnam lies about 40 km (25 miles) west of Hanoi. South Korea's Daewoo Group and a Vietnamese partner are also planning to open another $177 million golf course outside Hanoi.
The new course will be close to the northern beach resort area of Do Son, the site of communist Vietnam's only legal casino.
